_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Water (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Lin, Y.-F.[Yi-Feng], Tu, C. -H.[Chein-Hsiun], Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibria for the binary and ternary mixtures of 2-propanol, water, and 1,3-propanediol at p = 101.3 kPa: Effect of the 1,3-propanediol addition, Fluid Phase Equilib. 368 (2014) 104-111
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 11, 12. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0064. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.03 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
